GameDBLocalizedString.Text:
A giant space vessel emerged from the emptiness of space. No Gate Station was used, no engines were involved, just a precise jump.

Before the Princess and the surprised factions of the Siren System could assemble their fleets, the dropships had already begun to flood the sky over the planet Scylla.

Then the chaos on every communication channel was drowned out by a single voice speaking in an archaic dialect. "I am the Pathfinder! I guided the Xenauri Riders through the void of space! I have come to bring the usurpers of this system to justice!"

Se-Tri, a powerful Xenauri psyker, is leading one of the axes of invasion. Though her sister Se-Wari does not share those powers, she has been appointed her second-in-command.

Se-Wari found the most unlikely ally in the most unlikely place. Rogue Fossorian Captain Pick and his Sovereign crew want to create a counterbalance to the Princess’s monopoly on long-distance space travel.

Impressed by the capabilities of the Altari, a caste of Xenauri psykers, it seems he has found a perfect solution.

Our heroes aim to liberate one of the most powerful Altari, Se-Wari’s own sister, Se-Tri, from the hands of the Princess.

Captain Pick’s Sovereign friends tracked the Princess’s ship deep into the jungles of planet Chimera, home to the notorious Tumori Tribes.

Surprisingly, this is the same place where the Pathfinder summoned all of his surviving Altari Guard after the destruction of the Xenauri Mothership.

Our heroes can only guess at the motives behind the decisions of those “key figures.” Still, one thing seems clear enough: the only way to Se-Tri and her kidnapper leads through the dangerous Tumori forests.

The Xenauri have found a new home, but after a failed invasion attempt, they have once again splintered into many separate clans. Only a grave danger could unite them into one great army again. It will take a long time for the factions of the Siren System to accept them. Luckily, they have a powerful ally: the Princess.

During the chaotic aftermath of the invasion, the Xenauri have shaken off the yoke of their self-proclaimed ruler, the Pathfinder. His true intentions remain a secret, just as he planned.

With the Pathfinder dethroned, the days of his Altari Guard are over too. But many exceptionally powerful Altari have survived and now enjoy the freedom and relative plenty of the Siren System.

Before they return to their clan, Se-Wari and her sister, Se-Tri, decide to accept Captain Pick’s offer to explore the Siren System as part of his Sovereign crew.
